glosses: the ways and contexts in which spoken and written words are actually used, determined by a lexicographer's intuition or from corpus analysis (as opposed to correct or proper use of language, proclaimed by some authority)

examples.text: Ce mot est toujours en usage.
examples.en: This word is still in use.

examples.text: Fais bon usage de ton temps !
examples.en: Make good use of your time.

examples.text: Je vais en faire usage demain.
examples.en: I'm going to use it tomorrow.
